name: Rizuhble's Whack-A-Mole Mo
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Grit
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Their burst catches you while Scorn's on cooldown. Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-7,200 (levels 1-13). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Combo T1. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Cold Front.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 7.5 to Scorn's damage (0.75x scaling).
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Cold Front completes 4.8k spirit in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Cold Front completes 3,200 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Cold Front completes 4.8k spirit in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Quicksilver Reload
items.caption: Imbued on Scorn: the imbue charges up over 18s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 10% fire rate for 12s.

items.name: Cold Front
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Fortitude, 4000 souls (~4.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Fortitude, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Health
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Fortitude completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Fortitude completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 7,200-20,800 (levels 13-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Scorn T3, Burrow T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Scorn, damage) grows from 131 to 169. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Fortitude.

items.name: Fortitude
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Extra Health (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Torment Pulse
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Scorn: takes 18% off its 8s base cooldown.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 26.8 per second to Burrow's damage per second (1.49x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 10,400 to 11,200 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. | Imbued on Scorn: widens its range.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: component_for)

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Sand Blast: its duration-scaled parts (duration 2.5s) get +22%.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Combo channel time (2.4s), Scorn debuff duration (16s), Burrow channel time (9s). Takes spirit from 14,400 to 16,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Healbane
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus. | Temporary, sold when you buy Colossus later.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 188s; 20% off is 37.6s per full rotation.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 44.6 per second to Burrow's damage per second (1.49x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 20,000 to 24,800 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 31,200-49,600 (levels 30-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Sand Blast T3, Combo T3.

items.name: Colossus
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Pop it when you Combo someone in the middle of them. Sell Healbane for this.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 24,800 to 29,600 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Scorn radius (10m), Burrow radius (7m). Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Arctic Blast
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Torment Pulse.
sections.desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Torment Pulse.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Burrow (channelled). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry melts you up front.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps hurting you after the hit, like Infernus burn or Seven's ult.

items.name: Spellbreaker
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Big spirit bursts hit you as you pop out of Burrow.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Quicksilver Reload for 4,800 more souls: bonus fire rate 10 to 22; damage 44 to 60.. Imbued on Scorn: the imbue charges up over 14s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 22% fire rate for 12s.

items.name: Scourge
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: Cast it on yourself before you go in. Sell Superior Duration for this.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..
